subject: Human Body
title: Endocrine Disruptors
description: Learn Endocrine Disruptors in one minute.

hook.text: Chemicals in plastics, pesticides, and cosmetics can mimic hormones.

buildup.text: BPA, phthalates, and certain pesticides bind to hormone receptors.

discovery.text: Studies link endocrine disruptors to early puberty, fertility issues, obesity, and higher cancer risk in exposed groups.

climax.text: Endocrine disruptors exploit the body's own signaling system. By mimicking hormones, they hijack biology at low doses.

punchline.text: Plastic chemicals fool your body into obeying the wrong signals.

quiz.question: How do endocrine disruptors affect the body?
options: They bind to hormone receptors, mimicking or blocking natural hormones
They only affect the thyroid gland
